LESSON: PEACEFUL COEXISTENCE

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: People and Relationships
Topic 2.6: Peaceful Coexistence
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Peaceful Coexistence, part of People and Relationships in Grade 7 SOCIAL STUDIES.

Key inquiry question: How can we promote peace for mutual social well-being? 2. How can I manage stress and emotion to promote inner peace?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. outline the qualities of a peaceful person in the community,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Peaceful Coexistence in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. explore factors that promote peaceful co- existence,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Peaceful Coexistence in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. assess peaceful conflict resolution process in day- to-day life,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Peaceful Coexistence in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

D. value the importance of peaceful coexistence in the community in day-to- day life. Learner is guided to: ● brainstorm on the qualities of a peaceful person in the community ● write an essay on the qualities of a peaceful person ● use digital or print resources to find out peaceful conflict resolution process, ● engage a resource person to give a talk on factors that promote peaceful co-existence, ● role play in peaceful conflict resolution process in day-to-day life, ● compose and recite peace poems on the importance of peaceful co- existence in the community in day- to-day life. 1. How can we promote peace for mutual social well-being? 2. How can I manage stress and emotion to promote inner peace? 16

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Peaceful Coexistence together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Digital Literacy: learners use digital or print resources to find out the peaceful conflict resolution processes.

Values:
Peace: learners role play peaceful conflict resolution process in day-to-day life.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Social Cohesion: learners write down what they plan to do to improve inner peace and relationships with their family, school,

or community.

Link to other Learning Areas:

Learners use creative skills to compose and recite peace poems in class.
